mandatory_cases.expected: Exact independent fixture, zero tolerance; wrong-parent-equity negative control

A_C300: Compare three FIN case results and original 13 lineage witnesses against frozen Day2 expected fixtures
Zero unexpected changes to C300 model, snapshots, source identity or SQL meaning
B2_new_only: Run actual economic-measure applicability inventory against new-source schemas and declared model rules
PASS only when every applicable measure has a declared reconciliation or retained-not-modeled disposition
For SEC Daily Master filing-index-only sources, prove zero modeled economic measures and no leakage into FIN equations
An applicability PASS is not a claim of numeric reconciliation on these sources
C_combined: Execute three mandatory FIN contexts on C300 and actual combined output
Require exact fixture equality, negative control, source/run/locator/lineage witnesses, and zero old-versus-combined differences
Require independent full multiset source/record/field and duplicate-preservation checks

status_semantics.FIN_suite_PASS: All mandatory FIN cases executed/verified on corresponding present outputs and equal expected fixtures
status_semantics.new_only_applicability_PASS: Economic measure coverage audited; missing eligible measures forbidden; noneconomic input does not trigger fake numeric reconciliation
status_semantics.broader_economic_coverage: Separate explicit controls/dispositions; not implied by the three FIN cases

independent_stability.C2: Minimal controls: source namespace integrity; no unintended cross-source merge, split or collapse; source/lineage-stable FIN regression. Not enterprise canonical entity integration.
independent_stability.C3: Operational timings, completion and resume/replay evidence plus explicit accepted thresholds. FIN cases alone are insufficient.

historical_evidence_policy: Preserve historical NOT_APPLICABLE outputs and FIN_EVAL_V1 overlay verbatim; publish versioned current/future scorecards. Never retroactively rewrite frozen Day2 or PR23 records.
